task: curtailment-rate forecasting under a fixed reference operating policy (70% SNSP-type acceptance cap, reserve 0.10)

methods.DSTAR-GRU: GRU encoder + Siamese retrieval in learned embedding space + validated blend.
methods.Ridge: Ridge regression on the flattened window.
methods.kNN-RawFeature: k-NN retrieval in raw feature space (no learning).
methods.Ablation-NoSiamese: Retrieval in RAW feature space instead of the learned embedding.
methods.Ablation-SmallBank: Retrieval bank restricted to the most recent 168 hours.
methods.Ablation-LSTMEncoder: LSTM encoder with the same Siamese retrieval.

statistics: Mann-Whitney U two-sided + Holm per horizon on curtailment MAE
